description.zh:
已接入的资源ID，云产品接入时由WAF自动生成。

> 您可以通过[CreateCloudResource](~~2839876~~)接入资源后，查看响应中的资源ID。
description.en:
The ID of the connected resource, which is automatically generated by WAF in cloud native mode.

> You can call [CreateCloudResource](~~2839876~~) to connect a resource and then view the resource ID in the response.

description.zh:
WAF实例的ID。

> 您可以调用[DescribeInstance](~~433756~~)查询当前WAF实例的ID。
description.en:
The ID of the WAF instance.

> You can call [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) to query the ID of the current WAF instance.
The port of the cloud service connected to WAF.

description.zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

- **cn-hangzhou**：表示中国内地。

- **ap-southeast-1**：表示非中国内地。
description.en:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.
The ID of the cloud service instance.
The Alibaba Cloud resource group ID.
The type of the cloud service.

title.en: Re-connect a cloud service to WAF

example.unifiedCli: aliyun waf-openapi re-create-cloud-resource --instance-id waf_v2_public_cn-000 --resource-instance-id lb-bp000000000k5uj2p --port 443 --resource-product clb7 --cloud-resource-id lb-bp000000000k5uj2p-443-clb7 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-manager-resource-group-id rg-acfm000q --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
